modalities.evidence: heart R-wave to R-wave intervals, Oxygen consumption, and mechanical power output on a beat-to-beat basis
Clinical data of the participants (i.e. age, Weight, Height, Power at ventilatory threshold 1 and 2, and sport discipline) are provided in a separate file

output.population: 18 teenage athletes (15.2±2 years) from the Regional Physical and Sports Education Centre of French West Indies, in sprint kayak, triathlon or fencing
output.summary: Beat-to-beat R-R intervals, oxygen consumption and mechanical power output recorded during 18 maximal graded cycloergometer exercise tests in adolescent athletes, with a separate file of participant clinical and demographic data.
